newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.009pts to 101.426.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.009pts to 101.426.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.009 points in Wednesday's trading to 101.426, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.444 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, remained unchanged at 97.659 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.217 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.334 points to 1,120.168.
